facets.notes: 4 output ports: 'codes' (connect coders here), 'anchor', 'outlier_vals', 'outlier_idxs'. Outlier COUNT is stage-private scratch, serialized in FZM header. 1-D rejected (cuSZ-Hi has no 1-D path); setDims(nx,ny,1) picks the 2-D launcher. NOT graph-capturable — see caveats.

provenance.algorithm_origin: cuSZ-Hi multi-level spline interpolation predictor + quantizer

papers.title: Boosting Scientific Error-Bounded Lossy Compression through Optimized Synergistic Lossy-Lossless Orchestration
papers.authors: Shixun Wu, Jinwen Pan, Jinyang Liu, Jiannan Tian, Ziwei Qiu, Jiajun Huang, Kai Zhao, Xin Liang, Sheng Di, Zizhong Chen, Franck Cappello
papers.note: cuSZ-Hi — source of the multi-level spline interpolation kernels

caveats.graph_capture: Not graph-capturable: auto-tune radius scan and outlier-count D2H both sync the host. setQuantRadius(>0)+setAutoTuning(0) removes the scans but the outlier D2H remains.
caveats.error_bound: Error bound is a TARGET, not a hard guarantee — multi-level interpolation accumulates error: typically <= 1.1*eb, up to ~2*eb on outlier-heavy data.
caveats.dim_support: 2-D supported but uses a 3-D-like tile (AnchorBlockSize 16x16x1); auto-tune modes 1/3 are 3-D only and fall back to baseline in 2-D.

summary.one_liner: cuSZ-Hi multi-level spline interpolation predictor + error-bounded quantizer (2D/3D), lossy.
features: Multi-level spline (interpolation) decorrelation fused with error-bounded quantization
Radius auto-tune by default; set explicitly for deterministic/graph use
